notes: Actual capsule/KCC movement, not teleports or checkpoint skips.
All complete pilots choose safe branches; not an exhaustive risky-branch human playthrough.
CPU wall time and accelerated browser simulation are not target-hardware FPS.

limitations: Radeon 840M-class 1080p/60 FPS not verified; retained software gameplay captures measure approximately 1–3 FPS.
Physical controllers/wheels/rumble and audible audio mix not tested.
Every risky branch, fallback appearance and animation transition not exhaustively human-reviewed.
Mobile layout/touch-look are implemented, but no complete touch-only movement joystick.
Full city/driving/NPC/police/combat/radio systems are outside Steps 02/03.
